major_concerns: Emulator (Mininet) fidelity may under- or over-estimate production semantic errors; threat to external validity.
Integration complexity between LLM, Batfish, and emulation can create engineering noise interpretable as scientific failure.
Dataset/vendor heterogeneity may be insufficient to support general claims.
Unclear whether sample size/topology diversity is powered for paired McNemar tests and subgroup analyses.
Latency/operational-cost trade-offs (wall-clock repair latency) may reduce operational applicability but are not fully scoped.
required_design_repairs: Add a formal sample-size/power calculation and explicit topology/vendor sampling plan pre-registered.
Specify emulator configuration details and run sensitivity analyses vs higher-fidelity images or vendor templates; document known emulator limitations.
Predefine exact integration failure-handling and logging procedures; archive raw artifacts and hashes.
Predefine per-intent inclusion/exclusion and handling of timeouts; freeze retry policy.
Add explicit criteria for when emulation-observed results will be considered decisive vs verifier-only signals.

major_concerns: Composite metric depends on access to model-specific confidence signals that may not be generally available.
Predefined weighting scheme risks subjective tuning; post-hoc adjustment would invalidate claims if not strictly preregistered.
Emulation ground truth is imperfect; metric may overfit emulator artifacts.
Operational thresholds and decision utility require clearer operationalization for NetOps use.
required_design_repairs: Preregister exact weighting, thresholds, and ablation plan; lock weights before observing outcomes.
Provide fallback observable proxies for LLM confidence if model internals are unavailable (e.g., log-prob surrogates or ensemble variance).
Include an external validation split or cross-benchmark validation to test metric generalization beyond a single emulation corpus.
Specify how calibration and decision-curve thresholds map to operator actions and costs; include Brier-score-based calibration checks.

major_concerns: Adversarial construction and poisoning must be tightly contained; risk of harmful patterns spreading if not properly managed.
Results will be sensitive to the retrieval architecture; limited generalizability if only one retrieval setup is tested.
Ethical oversight and documentation of safeguards are currently underspecified.
Quantifying realistic adversary strength and mapping to real-world threat models is nontrivial.
required_design_repairs: Explicitly document and preregister ethical safeguards, containment, and non-distribution rules for adversarial payloads.
Specify and (if possible) vary retrieval architectures (vector DB, k, reranker) to measure sensitivity; preregister which variants will be reported.
Define and preregister precise adversarial payload templates, poisoning strengths, and seeds; include a justification linking strengths to plausible threat models.
Include safe-publication policy: provide sanitized examples only and archive raw adversarial artifacts under restricted access if needed.

major_concerns: Dynamic emulation of routing/convergence behavior may require complex vendor images or routing stacks, increasing engineering burden and reproducibility risk.
Batfish scope may not cover dynamic run-time behaviors leading to hard-to-interpret disagreement cases.
Potential confounding from mismatched timeouts, execution ordering, or environment differences between verifier and emulator runs.
Task taxonomy and stratification (ACL vs routing vs NAT) must be clearly operationalized.
required_design_repairs: Preregister exact emulation stack (which routing daemons/images), topology generators, and task taxonomy with justification.
Harmonize timeouts, execution ordering, and input parsing between verifier and emulator; preregister these operational parameters.
Plan and document qualitative analysis of representative false-negative cases, including root-cause attribution steps.
Provide sensitivity analyses showing how the verifier false-negative rate varies with topology size and task type; freeze stratification plan pre-execution.
